name: Revers.engineering
description: Applied reverse-engineering research on tracing, instrumentation, hypervisor-assisted analysis and integrity-check measurement.
limitation: A published tracing experiment and a simulated integrity-check harness do not establish current behaviour of any specific anti-cheat; this catalog did not reproduce the experiments.

name: Back Engineering → Aftermath Labs
description: Publication home of the deep dives accompanying Aftermath Labs' public research repositories, including the ring-1.io analysis.
limitation: The Back Engineering homepage redirected to Aftermath Labs when checked; article-level URLs remain the citation of record.

name: secret.club
description: Original, attributed anti-cheat and systems research, including the 2019 BattlEye analysis and the 2020 system-emulation study.
limitation: Independent researchers' dated observations are not vendor documentation; a publication about a sampled version does not establish current detection or enforcement behaviour.

name: Aftermath Labs research blog
description: Original research on static devirtualization of protectors used in game security, including Tencent VM, Themida and an anti-cheat kernel driver.
limitation: Articles cover selected artifacts and measured coverage; version information is sometimes unavailable, and the authors also sell obfuscation products, which they disclose.

name: Aftermath Labs ring-1.io artifacts
description: Repository accompanying the ring-1.io write-up, containing deobfuscated implant and loader artifacts plus an IDA database.
limitation: The repository also distributes cheat modules and implant binaries for analysis. This catalog links to it and does not host or mirror those artifacts.

name: UnknownCheats anti-cheat forum
description: Large public game-hacking forum whose anti-cheat sections are frequently the first place a question appears. Included as a discovery pointer.
limitation: Automated and browser retrieval both returned HTTP 403 / a Cloudflare interstitial on 2026-10-16, and the forum RSS endpoint returned 403 as well. Nothing in this catalog is attributed to a thread body that could not be read.

name: GuidedHacking anti-cheat forum
description: Tutorial-oriented game-hacking community with anti-cheat overview threads. Included as a discovery pointer.
limitation: Direct thread retrieval returned HTTP 403 and a browser visit hit a security-verification interstitial on 2026-10-16. Only indexed titles and URLs were available, not article bodies or claimed test results.
